archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO
summary: Scientific research results viewer & benchmark exploration dashboard for quantum error mitigation (QEM) across Bell, GHZ, and QAOA circuits with Qiskit Aer noise models, Pareto frontiers, statistical hypothesis verifications (H1-H5), publication figure gallery, and reproducibility telemetry.
target_audience: Quantum computing researchers, algorithmic benchmarkers, NISQ quantum software engineers, academic reviewers
design_principles: Precision over decoration: Crisp high-contrast monochromatic data density with laser-targeted cobalt/emerald accents.
Dual-comparison rigor: Explicit UI distinction between Comparison A (equal primary shots) and Comparison B (equal total budget including REM calibration & ZNE folding overhead).
Evidence-grounded navigation: Hypothesis verdicts (H1-H5), statistical significance badges (adjusted p-values, Cohen's d), and Pareto frontiers front and center.
Zero digital flatness: Subtle grid line borders, monospaced data readouts, and scientific badge chips with rigorous data-testid attributes.

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Menlo, Courier New, monospace
typesetting_rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing: tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Labels & metric overlines must be Uppercase + Tiny (text-[11px] or text-xs) + Wide Spacing (tracking-wider).
Numerical tables and stats (RMSE, Bias, Shots, Overheads, p-values) must render with font-mono for column alignment.
Never exceed text-5xl for dashboard headings; maintain clean information hierarchy.

contrast_rules: All normal text on dark cards must have minimum 4.5:1 contrast against surface backgrounds.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds on header, dropdowns, popovers, or floating modals; use bg-[#111622]/90 with backdrop-blur-md.
Hover text must explicitly declare text color e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white.

header.type: Fixed top bar with crystal glassmorphism and crisp 1px border
header.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#0B0E14]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10 px-6 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between
elements: Brand badge: QEM-Bench (Quantum Error Mitigation Benchmarks)
Benchmark engine indicator: Qiskit Aer & NISQ Noise Models
Primary Tab switcher (Overview, Condition Explorer, Interactive Charts, Publication Figures, Statistical Tests, Reproducibility)
Quick Action: Export JSON / BibTeX citation copy modal

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard inside the frontend React application with cleanly separated components in src/components/qem/ (OverviewTab.js, ConditionExplorerTab.js, ChartsTab.js, FiguresTab.js, StatisticsTab.js, ReproducibilityTab.js).

Include high-fidelity mock research data generated from realistic Qiskit Aer simulations with 4 methods (baseline, REM, ZNE, combined) over Bell, GHZ (3, 4, 8 qubits), and QAOA MaxCut (4, 8 qubits) across 3 noise rates (low 0.005, med 0.02, high 0.05) and 4 shot budgets (512, 2048, 8192, 32768).

Clearly highlight the core scientific findings: REM drastically reduces readout bias with low overhead (2^n calibration amortizable); ZNE reduces gate error bias but increases variance requiring higher shot counts; Combined achieves lowest RMSE at high noise only when total budget is sufficient.
Render the 12 publication figures gallery with zoom modal, high-resolution SVG/vector visuals, and academic LaTeX-style captions.
Ensure all dropdowns and popovers use solid dark background (bg-[#111622] or bg-slate-900) with proper borders and no transparent text collisions.
Implement Sonner toasts for copy citation, export data, and filter presets.
